Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring a fair announcement of concord grape prices.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the fair announcement of cash prices offered forconcord grapes grown in Washington; adding a new section to chapter20.01 RCW; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 20.01 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) It shall be a violation of this chapter for any agent, broker,cash buyer, commission merchant, dealer, or processor to purchase orreceive, or attempt to purchase or receive, concord grapes grown inWashington for use by a processor in the commercial production ofjuice, jam, or jelly unless (a) the processor sets forth a stated pricein dollars and cents of all amounts paid or to be paid per unitthereof, and makes the stated price available to any selling ordelivering party not later than the fifteenth day of August in the yearin which such grapes are to be delivered; (b) where a selling ordelivering party has a contract for delivery of such grapes to aprocessor, the processor has, not later than the fifteenth day ofAugust in the year in which such grapes are to be delivered, mailed tothe delivering or selling party written notice of the stated grape p. 1 SB 5963price and opportunity to refuse to deliver with respect thereto; and(c) the processor has mailed to the director not later than thefifteenth day of August of each year in which such grapes are to bedelivered, a written statement of the stated price to be paid for suchgrape or grapes. (2) Any notice required under subsection (1) of this section shallbe mailed using the United States postal service. The cancellationmark stamped by the United States postal service employee upon theenvelope or other appropriate wrapper containing any such noticerequired by this subsection shall be prima facie evidence of the dateof such mailing. (3) Subsection (1) of this section shall not apply to any contractor other arrangement for the purchase or sale of concord grapes (a)entered into prior to the effective date of this act; or (b) fordelivery to a cooperative marketing association or federationincorporated under, or whose articles of incorporation and bylaws areequivalent to, the requirements of chapter 23.86 RCW by a member patronor nonmember patron of such cooperative corporation.
